quickAnswer: Office cleaning cost in Boise, ID averages $34 to $59 per billed hour—2% below the US national average (0.98x)—with minimum per-visit trip charges of $88 to $132. blocks.text: Rapid corporate expansion across the Treasure Valley has tightened Boise's evening labor pool. While Boise sits just below the national midpoint at a **0.98x metro cost multiplier** and a **$16.17 per hour BLS median wage reference**, janitorial contractors from **Downtown 8th Street** out to the **Meridian Corridor** must compete with booming distribution, semiconductor, and healthcare hiring—putting realistic fully burdened billing between **$34 and $59 per hour**.

Facility teams comparing local proposals need to look past headline per-square-foot numbers. A bid priced at `$34/hr` that suffers constant cleaner turnover along Eagle Road will leave restrooms half-sanitized, whereas a well-supervised `$46–$59/hr` crew delivers consistent ISSA production speeds and keeps dry summer dust and winter road grit from ruining carpet tiles. See how Boise stacks up nationally in our [150-city office cleaning rate guide](/city-cleaning-costs/).
Boise, ID Office Cleaning Cost Matrix (2,000 to 25,000 Sq Ft)

The benchmarks below apply Boise's `0.98x` regional multiplier across US square-footage brackets (`$0.12–$0.20/sq ft` under 2,500 sq ft; `$0.09–$0.15/sq ft` for 2,500–9,999 sq ft; `$0.07–$0.12/sq ft` for 10,000–24,999 sq ft; `$0.05–$0.10/sq ft` at 25,000+ sq ft), plus `$15–$29` per restroom (`$15–$30 * 0.98x`) and standard frequency multipliers anchored to **4.333 weeks per month**.

How Flooring Mix and Seasonal Treasure Valley Wear Shift Quotes

Boise offices experience a two-season floor assault: fine summer dust blowing off dry foothills and farmland from June through September, followed by winter snow slush and traction sand tracked from parking lots between December and February. Keeping carpet extraction and VCT scrubbing on a regular schedule stops grit from grinding down fibers and acrylic wax.

Downtown 8th Street, Meridian Corridor, and Boise Bench Submarkets

items: **Downtown 8th Street:** Historic brick office suites, state-adjacent professional offices, and Class A towers near Capitol Boulevard combine hardwood conference rooms with multi-floor keycard security and paid garage access.

**Meridian Corridor (Eagle Rd / Ten Mile):** Fast-growing corporate parks housing fintech, healthcare-admin, and regional headquarters feature expansive LVT hallways, glass-walled collaboration rooms, and multi-restroom cores that benefit from 3x/week or 5x/week multi-person teams.

**Boise Bench:** Smaller 1,500–4,000 sq ft medical, dental-admin, and contractor offices along Vista and Overland offer easy ground-floor access, often pairing solo evening custodians with commercial upright vacuums (see our [ProTeam Super Coach Pro 6 vs. Hoover C2401 comparison](/commercial-vacuums-and-floor-machines/proteam-super-coach-pro-6-vs-hoover-c2401/)).

blocks.text: Idaho COI Rules and High-Efficiency Janitorial Closet Gear

Every commercial cleaning contractor operating in Boise must provide an active **Idaho Certificate of Insurance** listing **$1,000,000/$2,000,000 Commercial General Liability**, **Idaho Workers' Compensation** coverage (via the Idaho State Insurance Fund or an authorized private carrier), and a fidelity bond covering after-hours keyholders. Require **OSHA Hazard Communication (29 CFR 1910.1200)** Safety Data Sheets and **OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030)** restroom protocols in writing.

items.text: Verify Downtown and Meridian multi-tenant bids measure only net cleanable square footage inside your demised suite.

items.text: Require written backup-floater guarantees in your contract to protect against Treasure Valley staffing gaps.

faqs.q: How much does office cleaning cost per hour in Boise, ID?
faqs.a: Standard commercial janitorial contracts in Boise bill between $34 and $59 per hour (0.98x the US baseline), anchored to a $16.17/hr BLS median janitor wage reference. Specialty restoration tasks like VCT stripping and waxing or post-construction cleanup run closer to $55–$93/hr.

faqs.q: Why do Boise vendors charge $147–$294/month extra for quarterly floor care on a 5,000 sq ft office?
faqs.a: Base recurring pricing covers routine HEPA vacuuming and neutral damp mopping, not periodic hot-water carpet extraction or VCT machine scrubbing ($0.03–$0.06/sq ft/month amortized). In Boise, seasonal summer dust and winter snow grit make scheduled quarterly extraction essential to protect flooring warranties.

faqs.q: How do 4.333 weeks per month impact Boise janitorial billing?
faqs.a: Because a 52-week year averages 4.333 weeks per month (4.33 rounded), 3x/week contracts average 13.0 visits/month and 5x/week contracts average 21.65 visits/month—keeping monthly retainers level across short February months and five-week months.

faqs.q: What insurance and OSHA compliance should I verify for an Idaho cleaning contractor?
faqs.a: Require an active COI with $1,000,000/$2,000,000 Commercial General Liability (Additional Insured), Idaho Workers' Compensation coverage, a fidelity bond, OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) Safety Data Sheets, and Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) protocols.

faqs.q: Are Green Seal cleaners worth specifying for Boise engineered wood and LVT offices?
faqs.a: Yes. Green Seal GS-37 neutral-pH solutions strip winter de-icer residue and summer dust without dulling LVT wear layers or swelling engineered hardwood seams in Downtown 8th Street suites.
